stories.sz: 根据该国选举法院的数据，民粹主义候选人弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗对现任总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦取得了微弱领先，但巴西下一任总统将在第二轮投票中决定。

stories.t: Brazil presidential election 2026: first-round live results
stories.s: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is standing against Flávio Bolsonaro in the first round of the presidential race Brazil’s president is directly elected: each voter’s ballot counts equally and there is no electoral college. If no candidate wins…
stories.tz: 2026年巴西总统选举：首轮实时结果
stories.sz: 路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦在总统竞选第一轮中对阵弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗。巴西总统由直接选举产生：每个选民的选票权重相同，不设选举人团。如果没有候选人胜出……

stories.t: Forced to call him 'Dad': Trial over sexual abuse in disabled care home shocks South Korea
stories.s: The BBC spoke to one of three residents at a care home who were sexually assaulted by a staff member.

stories.t: What to know about Brazil's election as Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro face off
stories.s: Polls suggest the election will be a closely run contest between the left-wing incumbent and his right-wing rival.
stories.tz: 卢拉与弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗对决：关于巴西大选你需要了解的事
stories.sz: 民调显示，这场选举将是左翼现任总统与其右翼竞争对手之间一场势均力敌的较量。

stories.t: Indian police accused of sexually harassing journalists at protest
stories.s: The allegations were made after police detained dozens of protesters demanding the resignation of the election chief over changes to voter rolls.
stories.tz: 印度警方被指控在抗议活动中性骚扰记者
stories.sz: 此前，警方拘留了数十名抗议者，这些抗议者因选民名册变更而要求选举委员会负责人辞职。

stories.t: Yemen's government announces all-out war to reclaim land from Houthis

stories.sz: 在其中一人被起诉、其余五人下落不明之际，各方呼吁释放“Matsadaash”的六名员工。几天前，整个新闻编辑部被拘留，一名埃及记者随后被指控加入恐怖组织……

stories.s: Footage shows a drone hitting the Pivnichyi (Northern) Bridge as vehicles move across it, creating a large fireball.
